description: Header file defining the PackagerImplementation class and related nested classes, interfaces, and methods for package management in a plugin system.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the IPackager interface, managing package installation, configuration, and notifications.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Nested class for JSON configuration parameters related to packaging.

classes.name: PluginConfig
classes.description: Nested class for plugin-specific JSON configuration.

classes.name: PackageInfo
classes.description: Class representing package metadata such as name, version, and architecture.

classes.name: InstallInfo
classes.description: Class representing installation status, progress, and error information.

classes.name: InstallationData
classes.description: Struct holding pointers to PackageInfo and InstallInfo objects for ongoing installation processes.

classes.name: InstallThread
classes.description: Thread class handling background installation tasks.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification observer for package events.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the packager with a given service.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a package with specified name, version, and architecture.
